Injury event—place of occurrence, code (ICD-10-AM 8th edn) ANN{.N[N]}
Place of occurrence of external cause of injury (ICD-10-AM)
The place where the external cause of injury, poisoning or adverse effect occurred, as represented by a code.
International Statistical Classification of Diseases and Related Health Problems, Tenth Revision, Australian Modification 8th edition
External cause codes in the range V00 to Y89 must be accompanied by a place of occurrence code.
External cause codes V00 to Y34 must be accompanied by an activity code.

Enables categorisation of injury and poisoning according to factors important for injury control. Necessary for defining and monitoring injury control targets, injury costing and identifying cases for in-depth research.
National Centre for Classification in Health
National Data Standards for Injury Surveillance Advisory Group
